events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...South Central Polk County in east Tennessee...

* WHEN...Until 615 AM EST.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring, especially
along the Ocoee River. Streams continue to rise due to excess
runoff from rainfall to the south in Georgia.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 127 AM EST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
heavy rain due to thunderstorms. Flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly in the warned area. Between 2 and 3 inches of
rain have fallen in the warned area with heavier totals in excess
of 4 inches to the south.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are possible in the
warned area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Ducktown and Copperhill.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.summary:
...The National Weather Service in Peachtree City GA has issued a
Flood Warning for the following rivers in Georgia...

Mountaintown Creek at GA 282 near Ellijay affecting Gilmer County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring.

* WHERE...Mountaintown Creek at GA 282 near Ellijay.

* WHEN...From early this morning until further notice.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1:01 AM EST Thursday the stage was 14.5 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 1:01 AM EST Thursday was 14.5 feet.
- Forecast...No forecast is available for this location.
- Flood stage is 12.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 10.0
feet on 12/24/2015.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
FFWFFC

The National Weather Service in Peachtree City has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northwestern Fannin County in north central Georgia...
North Central Gilmer County in north central Georgia...

* Until 230 AM EST.

* At 121 AM EST, local law enforcement reported thunderstorms
producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between 5 and 6 inches
of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1.5 to 2.5
inches in 1 hour. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 3 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing.

FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY for Southern Fannin and Northern Gilmer. This
is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER GROUND NOW!

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Law enforcement reported.

IMPACT...This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER
GROUND NOW! Life threatening flash flooding of low water
crossings, small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Blue Ridge, Higdon and Colwell.

events.summary:

over the plains and gusts up to 80 mph along the immediate eastern
slopes of the Rocky Mountain Front.

* WHERE...East Glacier Park Region Zone, and Eastern Glacier, Western
Toole, and Central Pondera and Northern High Plains.

* WHEN...From Friday afternoon through Saturday morning.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult, especially for high profile
vehicles or for those towing light weight trailers. Isolated power
outages possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The strongest winds are expected Friday night
into early Saturday.
